title: MV SumRndmDude's Undertale Battle System plugin Query

posts.author: TechnoRad
posts.body:
Hi,
I've just been looking into this since I'm continuing to use RPG maker MV to develop a silly game with the goal of adding a bunch of references from other games within it. I stumbled across SumRndmDde's undertale battle system plugin and wanted to try and implement a battle or two that would utilise this (based off whatever the current version of the demo project he has put up on his website here:
http://sumrndm.site/undertale-battle-system/
).
I am already understanding of any potential errors between this and other plugins, but I'm not here to complain and try and find solutions to them as they occur, just wanted to know with the demo project or in general if there could be a way to toggle between the Undertale system and the regular sideview battle system. I've seen similar questions asked before but have yet to find a decent or functioning answer to my question (I am aware that a potential method to do this would be to peep into the plugins code and add some sort of method to toggle between the battle systems, but at the current moment I have close to no experience Javascript itself and the ToS when it comes to using SunRndmDde's plugins).
I have found some success with this regard with turning on the "Use SideView battle" system and stripping the party or ally members skills (allowing for sideview battle with some skills and stuff) and then having the enemy be able to utilise these undertale skills, which is close to what I intend to implement with this joke battle in my current project. However, I have yet to find a clear way to toggle between these battles modes.
In my current project I added the basic setup (essentially copying the ally skills and the donut enemies skillset over) and turning all my other plugins off to just have the undertale battle system ones. This results in the regular sideview battle system but it has the undertale battle system overlay (for my attacks, skills, items etc. example given below)
*note that Mercy/Attack option on the far left is due to the fact that my classes currently have two main skill types and I'll have to figure out how to fix that on my own
To be specific, I just want to know if there is a way to just toggle between this sideview and this undertale battle system in RPG Maker MV (the most recent version of the engine is used for my main project) so that I could implement a one-off or minigame type-battle.
In the meantime I will attempt to mess around with the demo project a bit more, I have only dumped about an hour or 2 messing around it so far just was curious if somebody else had found a solution. If I should drag this question along to the plugin maker themself then just let me know (obviously just about toggling the battle systems).
Worst case scenario I'll just plan to implement this later on or in another future project. Either way thanks for your time and I hope my query makes sense

posts.author: Midona018
posts.body:
I don't use it, but I read this in the plugin help
For a Skill to use the Undertale Battle System, place this notetag in it:
<Use Undertale Attack>
If you want to add minigames you could create enemies having the undertale skills and change them for normal foes in the main game?

posts.author: TechnoRad
posts.body:
I believe I've already been doing that, which allows me to use my skills in the attack window and just allows the enemies to use the undertale skills.
I did just have a thought as I haven't tried turning off only some of the plugins, because I believe only one of them might just be creating that alternate window screen for it as there is the main battle system plugin and 3 extra ones. I'll give it a go anyways when I next work on it and might read the page for it again as I might have missed something.
I'll keep playing around with that notetag as well and see what it can produce. Thanks for the help
EDIT Yeah that seems to be all it was. There isn't a way to turn the window or plugin itself on and off but I seem to get what I intend from this battle system now. All thats left next is to figure out how to ensure it functions with the rest of my plugins in my actual project
